## TRA Timeline

#### SPAC business combination and TRA execution

- 2023-02-13: Executed TRA dated as of de-SPAC close with Inflection Point Acquisition Corp., 85% of Net Tax Benefit to the indie OpCo founders (Altemus, Ghaffarian, Crain) and associated continuing members
- 2023-02-14: 8-K reports close and attaches the executed TRA as Exhibit 10.1
- 2023-02-15: 8-K/A refiles the same executed TRA for housekeeping; substantive text identical

## Explanation

Intuitive Machines executed its Tax Receivable Agreement at the February 13, 2023 close of the SPAC business combination between Inflection Point Acquisition Corp. and Intuitive Machines OpCo, paying 85% of the cumulative net realized tax benefit on Section 754 basis step-ups (from exchanges of OpCo Common Units for Class A stock), the Business Combination Existing Basis allocable to the public company, and imputed interest deductions on TRA payments. The TRA is legally in force as of the FY2025 10-K but the liability is unrecognized on the balance sheet because the company maintains a full valuation allowance on the underlying deferred tax assets while federal NOLs (roughly $73.9M at YE2025) prevent realization of the basis-step-up benefits. No amendments, restatements, or termination instruments are on file through May 2026; the August 2023 securities purchase, 2024 follow-on offering, and November 2025 Vantor/Galileo acquisition did not modify the contract. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing-by-filing record.
